correctness.rationale: Exact integer lattice slices lead to h*(z)=A_p(z)(1+z)^q and an integer-coefficient formula. The finite p+q≤17 enumeration fully covers all 136 pairs; 120 positive pairs at p+q≤16; only (14,3),(16,1) fail for p+q=17. Four p=14 cases verify reentrance. 1982 integer coefficient tests and 2122 independent direct-count checks pass; the finite classification does not use empirical extrapolation.

value.rationale: An exact first-failure threshold in a canonical joining of two individually Ehrhart-positive regular lattice-polytope families, together with nonmonotone reentrant positivity at fixed cube dimension, is a natural structural boundary. It distinguishes joining from Cartesian positivity-preserving operations and is a complete finite-range sign classification, not an arbitrary individual coefficient.
